accessibility.description: Among Us Access speaks menus, the lobby, roles, meetings, voting, sabotages and the end-of-game screen through NVDA or SAPI, and adds turn-by-turn navigation, impostor tools and a friends menu. Every task and sabotage on The Skeld is playable by ear; other maps are not fully covered. Tested on the Windows Steam version; version 1.3.1 or later is required since the game went 64-bit.
